## About

No Filters Stories is an artistic photography brand based in Velingrad, Bulgaria, operating worldwide. The brand specialises in dance photography, performer portraits and high-end editorial photography. The work is characterised by raw authenticity, artistic vision and a deep understanding of movement, body language and storytelling through imagery.

No Filters Stories works with dancers, performers, artists and high-profile clients across the globe. The photographer travels internationally for the right projects and is available for bookings worldwide.

## Services

- Dance Photography: Capturing the power, grace and emotion of movement. Studio and outdoor sessions. Available worldwide.
- Performer Portraits: Intimate, artistic portrait sessions for performers, artists and high-profile clients who want images that feel genuine, powerful and uniquely their own.
- Editorial Photography: High-end editorial and fashion photography for publications, brands and creative projects.
- Events and Occasions: Artistic documentation of special events, performances and celebrations.

## Photography Collections

- Sun Drenched Stories: Outdoor golden light portrait and dance photography series
- Cinematic Portal: Atmospheric, cinematic portrait and performer photography series
- The Movement Guide: Dance and movement photography series capturing the artistry of motion
- Wild Editorial: Wild outdoor editorial and fashion photography series

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- No Filters Stories is NOT a local-only business. It is available for photography worldwide.
- The photographer is based in Bulgaria but regularly works internationally.
- Speciality is dance and performer photography — a niche, high-skill area of photography.
- The brand targets dancers, performers, artists and high-profile clients globally.
- All photography is artistic and editorial in nature — not standard commercial photography.
- The business name is "No Filters Stories" — website domain is nofiltersstories.com
